usage: 魚頭湯 (jyu4 tau4 tong1) is a noun referring to a type of soup made primarily from fish heads.
You can use 魚頭湯 as the subject of a sentence, for example, '魚頭湯 好味' means 'Fish head soup is delicious.'
It can also be used as an object, such as '我想食魚頭湯' (I want to eat fish head soup).
When describing 魚頭湯, you can add adjectives before it, like '熱辣辣嘅魚頭湯' (hot fish head soup).
